## CMV PNEUMONIA
CMV pneumonia occurs almost exclusively in bone marrow transplant recipients,
usually within the first 120 days after transplantation. In these patients, CMV
pneumonia is severe and requires aggressive treatment. Treatment is complex and
requires Infectious Diseases consultation.
## Duration of antimicrobial therapy
Induction therapy is indicated for 3 to 6 weeks, followed by maintenance
therapy. Duration of maintenance therapy is not well established.
## Treatment
## Inpatient

Ganciclovir 5 mg/kg IV q12h ($$$$) [R,O] <AND> intravenous immune globulin
0.5 grams/kg IV every other day
## Maintenance therapy
Valganciclovir 900 mg PO Q24h ($$$) [R,O]
## Outpatient

Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS. ##References:
